name: Arabia for Investment and Development S.A.E.
source: Mubasher (english.mubasher.info) EGX financial statements page, Q1 section (source heading: 'Data presented for First Quarter for year 2026 and the comparative for each of the previous four years'); figures published in EGP thousands and stored here in absolute EGP
_unitNote: source page prints EGP thousands; stored absolute EGP (x1000)
source_note: Read from the Mubasher English-language EGX statement page in the cached probe of 27 Sep 2026. The page heading states the period shown is the First quarter of 2026 with the same quarter of each of the previous four years as the comparative, so the periods are labelled by quarter and NOT as full financial years. Operating plus investing plus financing cash flow equals the printed net change in cash on every period where the source prints all three.
